Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identification of the type of transaction. The following values are predefined: Withdrawal, QuickWithdrawal, WithdrawalForDisabledPerson, CashDeposit, Transfer, InternationalTransfer, PeriodicTransfer, CheckCommand, MobileTopUp, Moneo.

AdditionalIdentification.name: Additional Identification
AdditionalIdentification.definition: Additional identification of the type of transaction. The following values are predefined: Vodaphone, TMobile, Verizon.

Period.name: Period
Period.definition: Period of computation for the counters.

Count.name: Count
Count.definition: Number of transaction with the defined currency.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amount of transaction with the defined currency.
